newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Wella sees profit up 25 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Wella sees profit up 25 pct in 1997.

text.p: German haircare and cosmetics group Wella AG said it expects group profits to rise by 25 percent in 1997.
Chief executive Joerg von Kraushaar also said group sales next year were expected to grow by two to four percent more than the market, which was forecast to expand by about three percent.
Von Kraushaar said Wella expected a large rise in profit next year, although he did not clarify whether he meant operating or net results.
"You could also write 25 percent instead of large," he told reporters.
Wella said it expected operating profit to grow by somewhat more than 25 percent this year. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
